content.comment_body: Hi everyone, I am new to the forum and would appreciate assistance connecting to the web server of [product_name] using a static IP address from a different WiFi network. Could someone please clarify the exact steps I should follow? Thank you in advance for your help.

This thread is closed because the question has been posted twice. A similar topic titled 'Web server of [product_name] doesn't work for another PC' has been published in the [product_name] - Communication conference. Best regards, [user_name]
